title: Unbounded PCU mailbox and UBOX semaphore waits

owner.description: UncoreInitPeim PCU mailbox and UBOX semaphore waits

references.location: PCU mailbox waits ffe0a5dc and ffe05737

description: The PCU BIOS mailbox wait on 0A014090 bit 31 has no bound (ffe0a5dc, ffe05737; callers include B1 ffe11961 and the B7.12 task ffe13a13). The system-semaphore acquire in ffe60a25 (080240A8/AC bit 1 plus owner) and the VCU mailbox in ffe05aed (13004040) are unbounded too. The PCU keeps state across warm reset, so a PCU wedged by an OS freeze would hang MRC with the display frozen.
not_established: Training failure itself halts with b7 frozen; a self-cycling loop needs an outside reset. Whether the failure cycles by itself or holds b7 still needs confirming from camera captures.
remediation: Bound the mailbox waits and report a fatal error. No candidate.
